data.one_liner: An in-app debug kits platform for Flutter apps with built-in inspection plugins.
data.what_it_does: Provides an in-app debugging platform and floating panel for Flutter apps. It supports various built-in plugin kits for inspecting widgets, performance, memory, CPU, device info, console logs, network requests with Dio, SharedPreferences, and Provider states.
use_when: You need an in-app debug menu and inspection tools running directly inside your Flutter application during development.
You want to inspect widgets, performance, network requests, and local storage directly on device.
avoid_when: You only want to use standard external IDE devtools and do not need an in-app overlay.
You are deploying to production and want to avoid adding debug UI overhead.
strengths: Includes 15 built-in plugin kits covering UI, performance, device info, and storage.
Supports custom plugin kit development through the Pluggable interface.
weaknesses: Requires manual initialization and registration of plugins in the main method.
Some features rely on VM Service and may require extra CLI parameters like --disable-dds or --no-dds on physical devices.
data.setup_notes: Register plugins in the main method inside kDebugMode and wrap the root widget with UMEWidget.
